| Source | Heavy Atom Count |
|---|---|

| PubChem molecular formula `C20H19N3` (20 C + 3 N) | **23** |
| PubChem raw atom list (20 C + 3 N + 19 H = 42 atoms) | **23** |
| RDKit from canonical SMILES | **23** |

The PubChem `HeavyAtomCount` property field (**29**) is inconsistent with everything else. Three independent lines of evidence — the molecular formula, the explicit atom list, and RDKit parsing of the canonical SMILES — all agree the compound (Magenta Base / Rosaniline base / Fuchsine Base / Solvent Red 41, CAS 3248-93-9) has **23 heavy atoms**. The value 29 appears to be a data error in that particular PubChem property field.

Since 23 is **not** greater than 26, the answer is **no**.
